packageRules.description: Repo exception: a graphql major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval. Approve it once every @graphql-codegen/* package accepts it as a peer, or codegen fails.
Repo exception: nativewind 4 only supports Tailwind 3 (nativewind 5 is the Tailwind 4 line). Re-enable alongside a nativewind 5 upgrade.
Repo exception: solito 5 drops react-native-web on web and targets Next 16 and Expo 54+. Re-enable with the Expo SDK upgrade.
